messages:
noah (People Ops): Quick All-Hands follow-up thread on hybrid/office ops questions that popped up: 1) short-trip ride reimbursements, 2) desk hoteling rules at satellite hubs, 3) offsite childcare & travel assistance, 4) etiquette for mixed-presence sprints. I'll collect answers here so teams have one link.

hugo (Eng): For local Uber from airport to satellite: is there a one-way cap? Also curious about requesting a larger vehicle for gear.

cecilia (VP Product): Policy summary: rides are reimbursable with receipt. Standard cap $80 one-way metro; request manager pre-approval for larger vehicles or if you expect to exceed. If transporting equipment, note that on pre-approval.

noah (People Ops): To add: submit pre-approval in the travel form if you expect >$80 or if trip is international. Screenshots of ride receipts are acceptable.

maya (Design): Desk booking: can design teams hold a block for a 2-day workshop? What's the booking window?

felix (Facilities): Booking rules: hoteling stays in place. Reservations open 7 days out, max 3 reserved days per person in any rolling 14-day period. Team blocks for workshops allowed with 7 business days notice. We keep 12% of desks as same-day spots. Team-block requests go to the office-requests form.

hugo (Eng): Recurring exceptions for weekly pairing days? Our team wants Tuesdays every week.

noah (People Ops): Recurring weekly reservations require manager sign-off and are limited to once-per-week per team. For long-term needs, submit the recurring-space request; People Ops reviews monthly.

tara (Finance): Expense tip: set expense type to "team:travel" and include the project code. Reimbursements processed within 5 business days. For tips, up to 20% of fare is reimbursable.

cecilia (VP Product): Offsites: Product tentatively planning a 2-day working offsite in late July. We're asking managers to avoid scheduling major releases that week.

noah (People Ops): Childcare stipend pilot: People Ops proposing a $175 one-time stipend per family for company-funded offsites (requires invoice/receipt). Pilot limited to upcoming product offsite and requires manager sign-off.

felix (Facilities): For the offsite we're exploring a subsidized shuttle from the main airport and negotiated hotel rates. Final logistics will be in the offsite doc once approved.

notify-bot: Provisional event "Product Working Offsite (Tentative)" added Jul 27-28 to company calendar. RSVP optional.

hugo (Eng): Etiquette q: if a team schedules an in-person kickoff, how much notice should we give remote folks?

maya (Design): Recommend 72 hours for team-level in-person days; 2 weeks for cross-team workshops to allow travel planning. Also tag events with "collab-day" so other teams can discover them.

cecilia (VP Product): Leadership ask: teams to post collab days in channel and on the shared calendar. If you have accessibility or visa needs for offsites, contact People Ops ASAP.

noah (People Ops): Action items: I'll update the People Ops FAQ with booking links, expense examples, the childcare pilot details, and the pre-approval workflow. Will ping managers when dates are final. DM me for exceptions. :thumbsup:
